item.title: June 2026 - Deepseek API For Performance & Cost
item.description: (following post has been updated 5th of july, 2026) Intro A shift in LLM/AI usage: GitHub Copilot changed its user pricing. Microsoft changed the pricing. Nvidia & AMD are coming up with new laptops with 128 or more GB of VRAM to run agents and LLMs locally! But the prices of the chips are not going down; at the time of writing, the Nvidia RTX 5070 16GB is 65k INR.

item.title: Comparing Free Chinese Models For Daily Use - May 2026
item.description: Intro I wanted to test the performance and accuracy of the ai models at the time of writing this (May 2026, so I can leverage them in my day-to-day tasks). Currently, I am testing 3 models: 1. Deepseek (v4 just got released) 2. GLM 3. Qwen. Identifying a common task At the time of writing this, there are Tamil Nadu elections. I’ve made up my mind to ask the AI to visualize the TN elections and would rate them based on their accuracy and how beautifully they present the data.
